---
title: "Public Safety"
---

Police and Fire are El Cerrito's two largest General Fund departments and its most visible city services — together roughly 59% of General Fund spending in the FY2026-27 proposed budget. Given their size and their direct role in community safety, they get their own section here, separate from the broader Finance pages.

## Pages

* [Fire Department](fire/index.qmd) — Mission, stations, organization, staffing, and budget trend
* Police Department — coming soon

Each page reports documented facts, sourced to the City's adopted and proposed budget books, without attributing responsibility to any individual.
